# FusionX

> FusionX is a software engineering company that builds, improves, modernizes, and maintains
> business software — custom applications, e-commerce, APIs, internal business systems,
> databases, and infrastructure. It is not a design agency or a marketing/branding studio;
> the work is software engineering across the full lifecycle of a system.

FusionX works with businesses at any stage of a system's life: building something new,
optimizing or fixing an existing application, modernizing an aging architecture, migrating a
system and its data to a new foundation, or maintaining software on an ongoing basis. A
recurring theme in how FusionX frames its work: existing software and its data are treated as
assets to build on, not automatically discarded — modernization and migration are offered as
alternatives to a full rewrite wherever that is the more practical path for the business.

## Services

- Custom software development — web applications, e-commerce, APIs, internal business systems, MVPs
- Software engineering & optimization — backend/database/API performance, caching, refactoring
- Software modernization — architecture redesign, legacy modernization, scalability, service decomposition
- Data & system migration — database migration, schema/data transformation, validation, legacy-to-new migration
- Ongoing engineering & maintenance — bug fixing, security updates, monitoring, continuous improvement
- Technical assessment — an evaluation of an existing system's architecture, database, backend, security,
  and technical debt, producing a current-state analysis, root-cause findings, and a recommended roadmap

## Selected work

- Fuse API Hub (https://fuseapihub.com/info) — an API infrastructure and marketplace platform connecting
  API providers and consumers, covering distribution, monetization, and management.
- Washingtonia Nursery (https://www.washingtonianurseryqa.com/) — a business website with services,
  project showcase, gallery, and lead generation.
- VOH Opticians — an ongoing engineering and maintenance partnership covering e-commerce, POS, and backend
  systems for a customer-facing retail platform.
